properties.label:
Enter a description of each item of personal property to bequeath, each on its own entry line. 
Format as "My grandmother’s vase", "My 1973 Firbird", "100 shares of Exxon stock", "My coin collection", etc.
properties.forceRelevance: GeauxBequestType == "Personal property" || LiquidationType == "Personal property" || ROFRType == "Personal property"
properties.name: SpecificPersonal

properties.label: Municipal address of the property:
properties.forceRelevance: (GeauxBequestType == "Real estate" || LiquidationType == "Select real estate" || ROFRType == "Select real estate")
properties.name: SpecificAddress

properties.label: Property's tax assessor parcel id:
properties.forceRelevance: (GeauxBequestType == "Real estate" || LiquidationType == "Select real estate" || ROFRType == "Select real estate")
properties.name: SpecificTaxID

properties.label: Include furniture, fixtures, and contents located in the property?
properties.forceRelevance: (GeauxBequestType == "Real estate" || LiquidationType == "Select real estate" || ROFRType == "Select real estate")
properties.name: SpecificIncludeContents

properties.label: Legal description of the property:
properties.forceRelevance: (GeauxBequestType == "Real estate" || LiquidationType == "Select real estate" || ROFRType == "Select real estate")
properties.name: SpecificLegal

properties.options: [{"Name":"All real estate","Description":"All real estate"},{"Name":"Select real estate","Description":"Select real estate"},{"Name":"Vehicle","Description":"Vehicle"},{"Name":"Personal property","Description":"Personal property"},{"Name":"Business entity","Description":"Business entity (dissolution and liquidation)"}]
properties.name: LiquidationType
properties.label: Select the property to be liquidated:
properties.forceRelevance: (LiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$) || (ClientWillLiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$) || (SpouseWillLiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$)

properties.name: ROFRType
properties.label: Select the asset to be subject to a Right of First Refusal:

properties.name: DissolveEntity
properties.label: Enter the full legal name of the business entity to be dissolved and liquidated (E.g., "Roadrunner, L.L.C.")
properties.helpText: NOTE: Assets owned by the entity will be sold and the net proceeds distributed, unless inside assets are also subject to a ROFR or Specific Bequest. DO NOT select this option if you wish assets to simply be distributed from the entity. Instead, you may create a specific bequest of an asset owned by the entity.

properties.name: GeauxBequestType
properties.label: Select the type of property for this bequest:
properties.forceRelevance: !(LiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$) && !(ROFRBequests|map: id$|contains: id$) && !(ClientWillLiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$) && !(SpouseWillLiquidateAssets|map: id$|contains: id$)
